definitions.short: properly, length , i.e. a measure (of uncertain dimension)
definitions.full: H3530. kibrah [ כִּבְרָה ] noun feminine apparently distance , only in the phrase (ה)ארץ כִּבְרַת a distance of land or length of way , Gen 35:16 כ עוֺד ׳וַיְהִי ׳ה אֶפְרָתָה לָכוֺא , 48:7 כ ׳בְּעוֺד ׳א אֶפְרָתָה לָבאֹ , 2Kin 5:19 כ מֵאִתּוֺ ׳וַיֵּלֶךְ אָ֑רֶץ . The distance meant is uncertain, but from 5:19 it would seem to have been a short one; see further Di Gen 35:16 and Thes (Assyrian kibrâti is a (widely extended) territory, quarter of the world , etc., Dl HWB 315 ; according to Hoffm. GGAbh. xxxvi (1890), 23-25 perhaps the distance that one can see).
